units.source_text: 天色全黑之后，匂亲王派人送信来了。

en.t: After it had grown completely dark, Prince Niou sent a messenger with a letter.

units.source_text: 在这时候，此事亦可聊以慰情。

en.t: At such a time, even this could offer some comfort.

units.source_text: 二女公子并不立刻拆看来信。

en.t: The younger lady did not open the letter at once.

units.source_text: 大女公子对她说道：“还是镇静下来，坦率地回他一封信吧。

en.t: The elder lady said to her, "Calm yourself and write him a frank reply.

units.source_text: 我倘就此死去，恐有比此人更荒唐的人来缠扰你，很可担心。

en.t: If I were to die now, I fear that someone even more outrageous than he is might come and trouble you, and that worries me deeply.

units.source_text: 但得此人不忘旧情，偶通音问，别人就不敢胡行妄为了。

en.t: If only he does not forget his old affection and keeps in touch from time to time, others will not dare behave recklessly.

units.source_text: 故此人虽然可恨，亦有可赖之处。”

en.t: So although he is hateful, there is also something in him that can be relied upon."

units.source_text: 二女公子说：“姐姐想舍弃了我而先死，太无情了！”

en.t: The younger lady said, "Sister, to think you would abandon me and die first is far too heartless!"
She could not help covering her face and weeping.

units.source_text: 大女公子说：“父亲死后，我片刻也不想留在世间。

en.t: The elder lady said, "After our father died, I did not wish to remain in this world even for a moment.

units.source_text: 只因命运限定，所以苟延至今。

en.t: Only because fate had set its limit have I lingered on until now.

units.source_text: 我之所以贪恋今日不知明日的世寿而惜此生命，无非是为了你呀！”

en.t: The only reason I cling to this uncertain life, never knowing whether tomorrow will come, is for your sake!"
She then ordered someone to bring a lamp so she could read the letter.

units.source_text: 其信照例写得非常详细，内有诗云：

en.t: As usual, the letter was written in great detail, and it contained this poem:
